facts.business: Cosmic CRF Limited manufactures precision cold-rolled formed (CRF) steel sections, railway components, sheet piles, springs, forged components, galvanized products, and fabricated engineering structures for railways, infrastructure, and industrial applications.

segments.name: Manufacturing of CRF Sections, Railway Components, Sheet Piles, Springs, Forged Components and other engineering products

capacity_or_capex.item: Total installed capacity after acquisition of N.S. Engineering Projects Pvt Ltd and Cosmic Springs And Engineers Ltd
Planned capex at NS Engineering completed post NCLT takeover

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Significant advances to a related party for procurement of raw materials and capital assets outstanding at balance sheet date; assessed recoverability, commercial substance, and adequacy of IND AS 24 disclosures.

key_risks: Fluctuation in steel and other raw material prices
Changes in Government policies and public capital expenditure
Competitive pricing pressures within the engineering and steel industries
Supply chain disruptions and logistics constraints
Delays in execution of infrastructure and railway projects
Interest rate fluctuations and availability of working capital
facts.related_party_note: During the year, the Company advanced significant amounts to a related party for procurement of raw materials and capital assets, which were outstanding at balance sheet date. Auditor evaluated recoverability, commercial rationale, and IND AS 24 disclosures. Trade receivables from related parties detailed in Note 35.
